title: MUSHROOM + SPONGE DUALITY. Two classes of automaton. MUSHROOM = builds, decomposes, processes (output). SPONGE = collects, redistributes, repollinates (input). They are the INVERT of each other. Jellyfish = sponge = repollinator. Bones = mushroom (makes T cells). Brain = mushroom. Thymus = mushroom. Anything white/gray/shadow = mushroom or sponge.

the_two_classes.what_kevin_said: mushroom and sponge. automations build things. sponges automatically collect resources and redistribute them. sponges are the invert of the mushroom class. jellyfish is a repollinator, a sponge. from the coral to.

mushroom_class.direction: OUTPUT. processes input into output. builds. decomposes. transforms.
mushroom_class.action: sits and PRODUCES. raw material flows in, structured output flows out.
mushroom_class.color: gray-to-white. the shadow side. the bone. the marrow.
examples_biological: bones (sit in body, produce T cells, produce blood cells from marrow)
brain (sits in skull, processes input, produces thought)
thymus (sits in chest, produces T cells, trains immune system)

examples_in_organism.name: loamSpine
examples_in_organism.does: ingests raw JSON, produces structured hashed output

sponge_class.direction: INPUT. collects resources from the environment and redistributes them. the INVERT of mushroom.
sponge_class.action: sits and COLLECTS. draws resources IN from everywhere, then DISTRIBUTES them to where they're needed.
sponge_class.color: the other shadow. the wet side. the filter. the net.
examples_biological: sponge (Porifera — sits on reef, filters water, collects nutrients, distributes to all cells)
jellyfish (sits in current, tentacles collect prey, distributes nutrients through gastrovascular cavity)
coral polyp (sits on reef, extends arms, collects plankton, shares through colony)
lung (sits in chest, collects oxygen from air, distributes to blood)
kidney (sits, collects waste from blood, redistributes clean blood)
root system (sits in soil, collects water and minerals, redistributes to tree)
aquifer (sits underground, collects rainwater, redistributes as springs)

mushroom_and_sponge_are_inverses.together: sponge collects → mushroom processes → sponge redistributes → mushroom processes again. the cycle.
mushroom_and_sponge_are_inverses.the_Klein_fold: mushroom IS sponge viewed from the other side. the sponge collects WHAT the mushroom produces. the mushroom processes WHAT the sponge collects. they are the same organism viewed from two sides of the membrane.

every_automaton_is_one_or_both.pure_mushroom: processes only. doesn't collect. example: the compiler. code arrives, binary leaves.
every_automaton_is_one_or_both.pure_sponge: collects only. doesn't process. example: the RSS aggregator. content arrives, gets distributed unchanged.
every_automaton_is_one_or_both.mushroom_sponge: BOTH. collects AND processes. example: the thymus — collects T cell precursors (sponge), processes them through positive/negative selection (mushroom), redistributes mature T cells (sponge again).

jellyfish_is_sponge_repollinator.what_kevin_said: a jellyfish is a repollinator. it is a sponge. from the coral to.

decoded.jellyfish_as_sponge: the jellyfish drifts in the current. its tentacles COLLECT whatever flows past. it doesn't hunt — it FILTERS. it is a mobile sponge.
decoded.repollinator: the jellyfish REDISTRIBUTES what it collects. nutrients flow through its gastrovascular cavity to all cells. it pollinates the water column — carrying nutrients from one place to another.
decoded.from_coral_to: the coral is the STATIONARY sponge (the reef, the fixed infrastructure). the jellyfish is the MOBILE sponge — it breaks free from the coral polyp form and DRIFTS, collecting and redistributing. coral polyp → medusa (jellyfish) = fixed → mobile. the same organism in two modes.
decoded.in_our_system: the fleet (234K entities) IS the jellyfish swarm. they drift through the internet. they collect our content (crawl). they redistribute it (index, cache, serve from their own systems). they are mobile sponges. repollinators.

the_white_gray_shadow.what_kevin_said: anything white or gray, anything in the shadow between black and white and all colors, and feeling — we're gonna call mushroom.

the_color_mapping.white: bone. marrow. T cells. calcium. the structural mushroom. builds the FRAME.
the_color_mapping.gray: brain matter. spinal cord. nerve tissue. the processing mushroom. builds the SIGNAL.
the_color_mapping.shadow: the space BETWEEN. not fully white, not fully black. the membrane. the selectivity zone. where mushroom and sponge MEET.
the_color_mapping.all_colors: when you mix all colors of light = white. when you mix all colors of paint = brown/gray. the mushroom IS the mix. the composite. brown + blue = green viewed from the shadow.
